entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: A collision of Kaldheim's realms causing earthquakes, destabilization and war.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: Plane of ten realms in constant motion around the World Tree.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: Tree around which the realms of Kaldheim move.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: A sapling from the world tree that can create doomskars across the multiverse for New Phyrexia.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Uses Realmbreaker to invade other worlds.

entities.name: Invasion
entities.description: During it all ten realms collided, connecting Kaldheim as one plane.

events.summary: During the Invasion all ten realms collide, connecting Kaldheim as one plane.
events.quote: During the Invasion, all ten realms collided with each other, connecting Kaldheim as one plane.

relations.note: Lets New Phyrexia invade other worlds with doomskars.
relations.quote: allowing New Phyrexia to invade other worlds
